events.name: RARA RADIO X GG - Breakbeat Boulevard Session
events.description: Drum and Bass and breakbeat fans can follow our stream or join us at the location for an afternoon of the music you love.

events.name: First Flight
events.description: We're hosting a party at the Land Bouw Belang - a cultural hub in Maastricht. Expect Deep Drum and Bass you can get down and vibe to.

events.name: A Journey Through Time - Music for a design exhibit.
events.description: As part of Dutch Design Week, we're teaming up with Gloeiwormen to soundtrack their Groeipijn (Growing Pains) exhibition at Sectie-C. Expect a journey through how electronic music has changed and developed over the decades.
